### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | The pipeline's --outdir: SAMPLE/spaceranger/, SAMPLE/data/, integration/data/*.zarr and multiqc/. |
| `IMAGE_SAMPLE` | ✓ | Sample whose tissue image and spots the Tissue and Integration tabs read from integration/data/*.zarr, spelt as the store names it (letters, digits, _ and - only). |
| `INTEGRATION_METHOD` | — | Integration method of the run (--integration_method): names the integrated store METHOD.zarr the integrated clusters are read from. |
| `GENES` | — | Optional comma-separated var names (gene ids of the reference) to read from X; adds the Genes on tissue dashboard. Unset: pruned. |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (CSV): the pipeline's sample sheet or any table whose METADATA_ID_COL column holds the sample ids. Adds the design columns to the sample hub; pruned when absent. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design-table sample id column (links join on it). |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design column the group filter reads (the Visium slide serial by default); a hub without it gets one group, all samples. |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Title-cased GROUP_COL for display. |

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`nf-core/spatialvi/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/spatialvi/recipes/samples.py) | The nf-core/spatialvi sample hub: one row per sample, every design column. | `sample`, `input_route` |
| [`spaceranger/metrics_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/spaceranger/metrics_summary.py) | Tidy Space Ranger's per-sample `metrics_summary.csv` into typed columns. | `sample`, `assay`, `spots_under_tissue`, `number_of_reads`, `mean_reads_per_spot`, `mean_reads_under_tissue_per_spot`, `fraction_spots_under_tissue_pct`, `valid_barcodes_pct`, `valid_umis_pct`, `sequencing_saturation_pct`, `q30_barcode_pct`, `q30_read_pct`, `q30_umi_pct`, `reads_mapped_pct`, `reads_mapped_confidently_pct`, `fraction_reads_in_spots_under_tissue_pct`, `median_genes_per_spot`, `median_umi_per_spot`, `genes_detected` |
| [`spaceranger/tissue_positions.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/spaceranger/tissue_positions.py) | Space Ranger's capture spots, one row per spot of every sample. | `sample`, `barcode`, `spot_uid`, `in_tissue`, `under_tissue`, `tissue_call`, `array_row`, `array_col`, `pxl_row_fullres`, `pxl_col_fullres` |
| [`spatialdata/visium_cluster_composition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/spatialdata/visium_cluster_composition.py) | Spots per cluster of every sample, per clustering, as counts and shares. | `sample`, `clustering`, `cluster`, `n_spots`, `pct_spots` |
| [`spatialdata/visium_gene_expression.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/spatialdata/visium_gene_expression.py) | Expression of a chosen gene list per spot, one row per spot and gene. | `sample`, `spot_uid`, `x`, `y`, `cluster`, `gene`, `expression` |
| [`spatialdata/visium_spots.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/spatialdata/visium_spots.py) | The spots of a Visium SpatialData store, on a schema that does not move. | `sample`, `spot_id`, `spot_uid`, `x`, `y`, `array_row`, `array_col`, `total_counts`, `n_genes`, `pct_counts_mt`, `pct_counts_ribo`, `pct_counts_hb`, `cluster`, `cluster_integrated`, `integration_method` |
| [`squidpy/spatial_autocorr.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/squidpy/spatial_autocorr.py) | Spatially variable genes of every sample, on one schema whatever the statistic. | `sample`, `gene`, `gene_uid`, `method`, `statistic`, `spatial_score`, `pval`, `qval`, `neg_log10_qval`, `rank`, `significant`, `significant_flag` |
